mapper.select: select id, user_id, available_credits, frozen_credits, total_granted_credits, total_used_credits, status, create_time, update_time from credit_account where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into credit_account( user_id, available_credits, frozen_credits, total_granted_credits, total_used_credits, status, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{availableCredits}, #{frozenCredits}, #{totalGrantedCredits}, #{totalUsedCredits}, #{status}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update credit_account set available_credits = available_credits + #{availableCredits}, total_granted_credits = total_granted_credits + #{totalGrantedCredits}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'NORMAL'

update credit_account set available_credits = available_credits - #{availableCredits}, total_used_credits = total_used_credits + #{totalUsedCredits}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'NORMAL' and available_credits >= #{availableCredits}
